explication: This is the D&D 5e game system for Foundry Virtual Tabletop. A player or GM opens a system sheet or gameplay control, selects an actor/item activity, configures rules or dice, and receives persisted document changes and chat results. The graph separates UI applications, document/runtime orchestration, system data models, and rules/presentation services. Several relationships are inferred from documented module responsibilities and sampled imports; unsampled integrations are kept separate or omitted.
